summary: The learner got 2 of 6 right on Subtracting Negative Numbers. The wrong answers in 1, 2, 4, and 6 share one habit: when seeing minus a negative number, the learner takes away instead of adding. Problems 3 and 5 were right because they only needed taking away a positive. When doing the practice together, rewrite each minus a negative as plus before solving. The 5-problem practice sheet targets exactly that.
